history.name: Assistant
history.content: ISBN-10 check digit method: take the first 9 digits, multiply each by its position (1 through 9), sum the products, then choose the check digit such that the total including the check digit is a multiple of 11. If the computed value is 10, the check digit is 'X'. Tropicos IDs, when present, are numeric and often appear in the URL of the taxon page. Once we have the ID, we can pad with leading zeros if necessary to form 9 digits.

history.name: Assistant

This is shown on the taxon page at https://www.tropicos.org/taxon/40064321 and confirmed via their endpoint GET https://api.tropicos.org/taxon/40064321, which lists the name "Helotiales" with rank Order. This is the authoritative numeric identifier for Helotiales in Tropicos.

history.name: Orchestrator

history.name: Assistant
history.content:
Using ID 40064321 (8 digits), pad to 9 digits: 040064321.
Positions 1–9 multiply each digit: 0×1=0, 4×2=8, 0×3=0, 0×4=0, 6×5=30, 4×6=24, 3×7=21, 2×8=16, 1×9=9.
Sum = 0+8+0+0+30+24+21+16+9 = 108.
108 mod 11 = 9, so the check digit is 9.
The ISBN-10-style sequence would be 0400643219.
